visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Check Is Inverted
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The first duplicate in 2 5 3 5 2 is 5, but the program prints 2.

solution.explanation: add returns true when the value is new and false when it was already in the set. A duplicate is the case where add returns false, so the test needs the negation !seen.add(n). Without it the method returns at the very first (new) element.
